regime_evidence.interpretation: Current BNB Chain activity is not a qualifying organic speculative-capital regime: stablecoin retention is nearly flat, spot DEX volume is shrinking, and perp growth materially exceeds spot growth.

wash_trading_evidence.source: Bitquery Research, on-chain investigation published/verified Sep 23 2026
wash_trading_evidence.mechanism: The same USDT was cycled into and immediately out of tiny newly created PancakeSwap V2 pools 20-230 times per transaction; no USDT changed hands net. The wallet and linked bot farm dominated the targeted tokens, with at least 97% of recorded trading in the 126 tokens attributable to the loop/farm activity.
wash_trading_evidence.tracker_attribution: GeckoTerminal counted the checked loops. Bitquery states DefiLlama BNB Chain totals were too small to include the loops, so this finding does not directly contaminate the DefiLlama chain-level DEX series used by the framework.

framework_impact.new_token_activity: HARD_DISCOUNT_OR_REJECT when volume/holder/popularity evidence is traceable to the identified loop/farm pattern or similar correlated routing.
framework_impact.geckoterminal_pool_volume: Do not treat raw new-pool volume, first-minute buyer counts, graduation, or apparent wallet breadth as organic without wallet-funding and router/contract independence checks.
framework_impact.defillama_chain_metrics: Retain current use; this specific Bitquery mechanism appears excluded from DefiLlama's BNB Chain aggregate according to the investigation.
framework_impact.bnb_token_structural_gate: PASS_WITH_CAVEATS; the wash-trading evidence concerns application/new-token activity and does not establish a sellability, mint/freeze, supply-control, or liquidity failure for native BNB.

paper_portfolio.decision: HOLD; no add and no trim. The chain-level organic regime is weak, but the new evidence is not a native-BNB structural failure and the position is an opening-core holding below concentration limits.

major_uncertainties: Bitquery's broader BNB Chain volume count differs methodologically from DefiLlama, so the 35% contamination share must not be applied mechanically to DefiLlama's series.
The beneficial owner and motive behind the holding wallets/contract remain unresolved.
Other wash-trading mechanisms may exist outside the identified wallet/farm and outside DefiLlama's filters.
why_now: This is directly relevant to the framework's hard rejection gates because it proves that very large apparent volume, thousands of wallets, and newly launched token activity on BNB Chain can be generated by a tightly linked bot/holding-wallet structure at negligible net capital cost.
prospective_tests: For any future BNB-chain candidate, trace top-volume wallets, funding relationships, router/contract reuse, LP ownership, and net stablecoin movement before crediting volume or wallet growth.
Require discretionary retained-capital evidence at chain level (stablecoin/bridge inflows plus spot persistence) rather than raw token-launch volume.
Do not promote a BNB-chain candidate if its activity materially overlaps 0xf9ffcdc5 or correlated holding/farm wallets unless independent organic volume clearly dominates.
